title: Iran, Pakistan, Turkey and Saudi Arabia hold first quadrilateral meeting on regional security in Tehran
text:
Iran, Pakistan, Turkey and Saudi Arabia hold first quadrilateral meeting on regional security in Tehran"

"· The first four-country regional meeting was held in Tehran on 26 October 2026."

"· Iran’s SNSC Secretary Mohsen Rezaei hosted the talks."

"· Participants included Saudi Defense Minister Prince Khalid bin Salman, Pakistan’s armed forces commander Asim Munir, and Turkish intelligence chief Ibrahim Kalin."

"· The four countries agreed to continue dialogue to strengthen cooperation, including on regional peace and security.
